concerns.text: FR-001 references '(See US-1)' but no User Story ID 'US-1' is defined elsewhere; the user stories are titled 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc. This undefined cross‑reference breaks traceability.
FR-005 references '(See US-1)' and FR-006 references '(See US-2)'; similarly, FR-007 references '(See US-3)'. No IDs 'US-1', 'US-2', or 'US-3' exist, causing missing links.

FR-006 states the latency must not exceed 200 ms for at least 95 % of queries, while Constitution Principle VI requires latency to be maintained under 200 ms (implicitly for all queries). This creates a contradictory performance requirement.
